description: SceneScan is a targetless laser position reference sensor that tracks by matching live scans of the surroundings against a map built from earlier observations, so no reflectors are needed. features: No targets or prisms, so no target maintenance
Automatic reference point selection (SLAM based)
Positions off the whole scene, not a discrete target
Modular rotor design for in-vessel servicing
Won DP Award 2020 (per site)
